# `mise daemons tui`

- **Usage:** `mise daemons tui [ARGS]…`
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/daemons.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/daemons.rs)

[experimental] Open the pitchfork dashboard

Requires a running pitchfork supervisor. Takes `pitchfork tui` flags, not daemon names.

## Arguments
- **`[ARGS]…`** — Flags passed to `pitchfork tui`

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
